outcomes.rule_text: alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"Possible TCP Port Scan Detected"; threshold: type threshold, track by_src, count 60, seconds 300; classtype:network-scan; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 2222 (msg:"Possible SSH Brute Force Attempt"; flow:to_server; threshold: type threshold, track by_src, count 10, seconds 300; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ATTACK-RESPONSES Gobuster Web Directory Bruteforce"; flow:established,to_server; http.user_agent; content:"gobuster"; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 30, seconds 300; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert udp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 53 (msg:"DNS Query Flood targeting flood-test.example"; dns.query; content:"flood-test.example"; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 100, seconds 60; classtype:denial-of-service; sid:1000000; rev:1;)
